text: Hanwha Life's shareholding page lists its shareholders as of 31 December 2025: Hanwha Corporation 43.24%, treasury stock 13.49%, retail investors (incl. employee ownership) 12.84%, foreign institutional investors 10.2%, Korea Deposit Insurance Corporation (KDIC) 10%, domestic corporations 8.48% and Hanwha Galleria Timeworld Co., Ltd. 1.75%.
short: Hanwha Life's largest shareholder is Hanwha Corporation with 43.24% (31 December 2025).
